entities.name: Verdeloth
entities.description: Verdeloth the Ancient, a legendary magnigoth treefolk of Yavimaya who guarded the forest and fought in the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Rith's Grove
entities.description: The grove watched over by the magnigoth treefolk.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The 4205 invasion of Dominaria in which Verdeloth fought.

entities.name: Temporal crisis of Dominaria
entities.description: The 4500 crisis Verdeloth is unlikely to have survived.

events.summary: During the Phyrexian Invasion Verdeloth and the other magnigoth treefolk watching over Rith's Grove fight in the plane's defense.
